summary: Edgemode, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a securities purchase agreement with an accredited investor, under which it issued a $300,000 convertible promissory note with a $50,000 OID, netting $250,000 for working capital. The note matures August 3, 2026, bears 12% interest, and is convertible at $0.01/share post-180 days or upon default, with step-down reset provisions. No board recommendation or advisor are named; the filing is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
